scope: Theorem 1 (Nonsingular systems) of the manuscript “Nonsingular systems of equations over arbitrary groups” (preprints/Nonsingular-systems-of-equations-over-arbitrary-groups-October-5-2026/nonsingular-systems-over-arbitrary-groups.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 256 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 732c93a33db2c8c7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let G be any group, let 1 ≤ m ≤ n be integers, and let w1, . . . , wm ∈ G ∗ Fn. If their exponent-sum matrix has row rank m over Q, then the canonical homomorphism G −→ (G ∗ Fn)/⟨⟨w1, . . . , wm⟩⟩ is injective. Equivalently, the system has a simultaneous solution in an overgroup of G.
